mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_reservation (user_id, book_id, reserve_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, b.book_name, b.author FROM t_reservation r LEFT JOIN t_book b ON r.book_id = b.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.reserve_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_reservation SET status = 3 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_reservation SET status = 1, notify_time = NOW() WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY reserve_time ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, b.book_name, b.author, u.email FROM t_reservation r LEFT JOIN t_book b ON r.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.book_id = #{bookId} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.reserve_time ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status IN (0, 1)
SELECT book_id FROM t_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN (0, 1)
SELECT r.*, b.book_name, b.author FROM t_reservation r LEFT JOIN t_book b ON r.book_id = b.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_reservation SET status = 2, notify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
